correctness.rationale: The prior formulas give \(\tau=\alpha\beta/(\alpha+\beta-\alpha\beta)\), \(\rho=3\alpha\beta/(2\alpha+2\beta-\alpha\beta)\), and \(\xi_{Y\mid X}=2\alpha^2\beta/(3\alpha+\beta-2\alpha\beta)\). Solving the fixed-\(t\) relation yields \(\beta=t\alpha/(\alpha(1+t)-t)\) on the admissible interval. Substitution gives \(\Xi_t(\alpha)=2t\alpha^2/(\alpha(t+3)-2t)\) with derivative \(2t\alpha(\alpha(t+3)-4t)/(\alpha(t+3)-2t)^2\), so the unique minimum and endpoint supremum are exactly the stated values. Fresh symbolic factorization also reproduced the sign rule for \(\xi_{Y\mid X}-\xi_{X\mid Y}\). Direct substitution makes \(\rho=3t/(2+t)\); the standard Marshall--Olkin upper-tail formula \(\lambda_U=\min(\alpha,\beta)\) yields the stated range and inversion for the unordered pair.
residual_risks: The range is internal to the Marshall--Olkin family and should not be read as an extremal theorem over all copulas with fixed Kendall tau.

value.rationale: Kendall tau, Chatterjee xi, Spearman rho, and upper-tail dependence are standard but inequivalent dependence summaries. Determining the exact directional-predictability range and identifiability geometry on a fixed-Kendall fiber gives a natural complete classification showing both quadratic-to-linear weak-dependence separation and directional information invisible to symmetric concordance.

final_claim: Within the two-parameter Marshall--Olkin copula family, fixing Kendall's \(\tau=t\in(0,1)\) gives the sharp directional Chatterjee range \([16t^2/(t+3)^2,\ 2t/(3-t))\); the minimum is uniquely attained at \((\alpha,\beta)=(4t/(t+3),4t/(1+3t))\), Spearman's \(\rho\) is constant on the fixed-\(t\) fiber, the sign of directional asymmetry is the sign of \(\alpha-\beta\), and \((t,\lambda_U)\) identifies the unordered parameter pair.
limitations: The range is internal to the Marshall--Olkin family and should not be read as an extremal theorem over all copulas with fixed Kendall tau.
